notes.title: Trading Cards added to Burokku Girls!
notes.content:
Hi guys,

They're here! By popular request, we're hyped to reveal today that [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] have been added to Burokku Girls!

You can collect a total of 10 epic trading cards, and each one includes a bit of story on the character. Plus you can pick up badges, profile backgrounds and more!

Have fun collecting them all!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/443980

- Silver Cow Studio
